summary: Verified SMTP mailbox switch from SupportTeam@mercariglobals.com to email@support.mercariglobals.com. All 6 targeted tests pass: env values correct, direct SSL SMTP login to smtp.hostinger.com:465 succeeds, backend process env picked up new SMTP_USER, services.mailer.send_email returns {ok: True, provider: 'hostinger'} on a self-send, POST /api/support/tickets returns email_sent=true, and no post-restart '5.7.1 Disabled by user from hPanel' occurrences in backend supervisor log tail. SMTP throttling fix confirmed effective.
critical_code_review_comments: services/mailer.py correctly re-reads env via os.environ.get on every call (no caching) — the fix is genuinely env-only.
Unrelated pre-existing failures observed in test_iteration28_email_stripe.py (Stripe removed in iter 37); not caused by this change and out of scope.
seed_data_creation: None. One self-send test email delivered to email@support.mercariglobals.com and one support ticket created via API (channel=email).
context_for_next_testing_agent: SMTP now flows through Hostinger mailbox email@support.mercariglobals.com. Any new '5.7.1 Disabled by user from hPanel' in logs after 2026-08-25 06:59 UTC would be a real regression. Reusable pytest at backend/tests/test_iteration60_smtp_new_mailbox.py covers env sanity, direct SSL login, backend proc env inspection, direct mailer call, and end-to-end support ticket send.
rca of the issue: Root cause: Hostinger disabled the SupportTeam@mercariglobals.com mailbox (hPanel throttle → '554 5.7.1 Disabled by user from hPanel'). Mitigation: created new mailbox email@support.mercariglobals.com in Hostinger with password 8207@Bit; updated SMTP_USER, EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS, SUPPORT_EMAIL in /app/backend/.env; restarted backend supervisor. Mailer service re-reads env each send, so no code change needed. Verified via direct smtplib.SMTP_SSL login (235 OK), aiosmtplib send via services.mailer.send_email returning {ok:true, provider:'hostinger'}, and POST /api/support/tickets returning email_sent=true.
